verdict.rationale: A remote-desktop SaaS that processes session data could plausibly offer a control over AI training use, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use opt-outs, or a training policy. The pack covers only the CLI, the REST API, account management, and community discussion of the 2024 breach, none of which addresses this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
